sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:

Overall, the core gameplay mechanics of Mummy Land are simple yet addictive, with a focus on speed and agility. The level design is carefully crafted to provide a unique and exciting experience, and the power-ups and collectibles add an extra layer of excitement and replayability to the game.
